nom: TULA Revive & Rewind Revitalizing Eye Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including a dry patch or dry crinkled under-eye skin, report the cream is hydrating and soothing, though one dry-skin user found it did not retain moisture well enough over the day.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report the cream is non-irritating, cooling, and even a life saver for sensitive under-eyes, while several others describe burning, itching, redness, and swelling, with one linking the reaction to alcohol in the formula.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as older or dealing with aging skin report reduced fine lines, plumper under-eyes, and less tired-looking eyes, with results some say take a few weeks to appear.
segments.combination: One reviewer with dry, oily, combination, sensitive, acne-prone skin reports the cream is moisturizing without residue and works well for her overall skin type mix.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly fewer fine lines, smoother texture, and a plumper under-eye area, some within a week, others noting it takes a few weeks; two reviewers saw no improvement in lines or firmness after finishing a full jar.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe the cream as strongly moisturizing and hydrating, resolving severe dryness, flaky patches, and eyelid dryness; one reviewer found it did not retain moisture well and needed a second product mid-morning, and another received a dry, chunky jar.
concerns.redness: Reviewers using it for redness and flakiness report it worked after one application and reduced sensitivity-related redness, but others report the product itself caused red, inflamed, or itchy skin around the eyes.
concerns.barrier: Some sensitive-skin users describe the cream as calming and protective, preventing dryness and cracking, while a few describe burning and swelling suggesting a compromised or reactive barrier response to the formula.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers with acne-prone skin report zero breakouts and no issues using it near the eye area, with no dissent reported.

aspects.libelle: Long-lasting, a little goes a long way
Jar dispenses well and shows product level
Jar arrived underfilled or hard to dispense
Causes makeup clumping or poor eyeliner wear in AM

extraits.texte: I bought this eye cream at the recommendation of 2 ulta associates based on my incredibly sensitive skin due to retinol usage (even though I don't use it around my eye area). Every time I've used it my skin burns, itches, and becomes inflamed. I realized there is alcohol in this product, too, which ended up drying out my skin and making it crepe-y. Don't recommend at all. Would have returned but I threw away the packaging!

I didn't believe this eye cream was supposed to do everything it claimed to do, but I tried it anyways. I tried and tried it, made the skin around my eyes dry, red, and swollen! I've never had this type of reaction to an eye cream before. This is my fifth Tula product that I've purchased/sampled and I'm disappointed with the WHOLE line! Waste of time and money.

So, I used to use Clinique eye cream which was great but it was very thick and oily as well as a little hard on my eyes. I decided to try this, as I already love my other Tula products. I was a little skeptical at first because it's not as thick and oily, only for it to turn out that it makes it so much better. This eye cream is so moisturizing without the residue, and it is amazing for sensitive skin. A little goes a very long way. For reference, I have very dry, very oily combination skin that is sensitive and prone to acne. This makes my eyes look and feel great. I will continue to use this product. It is worth the price, to me anyway.

I hadn't bought an eye product or eye cream by Tula before but just did during a great sale. I'm a young 66 year old and have dry skin. My under eye crinkles and slight redundant skin there has been a problem since my late 30's! I have tried so so many in my day and can say this cream is really nice, soothing with a perfect texture for dry eye skin. It's like a creamy balm that hydrates and makes my under eyes protected instead of just sinking in like a thin gel-cream type which disappears into my skin. Under my eyes feels so nice and hydrated for a long while without any greasy film and makeup application friendly. Like this this eye cream and impressed as I'm new to Tula. I'm looking for more items in the line now! Please never stop making this.

extraits.titre: Ticks Some Boxes But Better Options Available
extraits.texte: I am a chronic "face sleeper" and have been battling fine lines under one eye for the last several years. Combined with genetic bags and early wrinkling in the same area, a super-hydrating eye cream with a lot of staying power is a must. I tried this TULA cream because the cost was fairly on-par with other popular options, I've used TULA before and liked some of their products, it is cruelty-free, and the packaging is recyclable. As for pros, this eye cream lasted a long time with daily AM use and the occasional PM use. I ordered this sometime pre-2022 from Ulta and started using sometime in 2022 so it's lasted at least a year. I use a little less than a pea-sized amount under my eyes and on my smile lines each day so a little can go a very long way. However, while the formula is thick (think Cera Ve Moisturizing Body Cream-thick), it does not retain moisture well so I have to reapply another eye cream mid-morning to keep my eyes from feeling too dry. The thick formula has a tendency to create makeup clumping under my eyes, which makes a bad problem worse and draws attention to the area. As well, I have seen my eye area continue to get worse since using but improve vastly since incorporating a different eye cream mid-morning. I ultimately finished the jar by using it on my chest and neck and will not repurchase. I think there are better options out there at a much lower price point with better benefits that tick my other needs.

extraits.titre: Best eye cream I've tried so far
extraits.texte: I have super sensitive eyes, redness and flakiness. This product worked after one application. I've tried every single eye cream and I finally told myself it's worth paying for an eye cream if it's really gonna work. This was a great buy. Would highly recommend.

I bought this product as an add on to my normal, cleansing for acne prone skin, products order. I was almost out of my other eye cream and I thought I'd give this a try since I like Tula's other products. I really had no expectations any direction. I am EXTREMELY impressed! I've been using this since the beginning of December and because I wasn't expecting anything the results caught me by surprise and are definitely noticeable. I work a hectic schedule that includes all night call in cardiology; I have noticed my under eye bags increase over the last year. This product has seriously reversed my zombie appearance. I wish I had before and after photos! I am a believer and committed customer. Thanks for another awesome product!
